title: Retractable Wall Hook 2-1/2-Inch Extension, 15 Lb Capacity | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Keep towels and robes within reach without a hook that sticks out all the time. The Carolina retractable wall hook extends to give you usable hanging space, then pushes back in when you want a cleaner look—ideal for tight bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Save space on busy walls: retractable rod pulls out for 2-1/2" of hanging space and pushes back in when not in use
- Hang everyday essentials securely: holds up to 15 lb for bath towels, robes, and clothing
- Coordinate a traditional bath: designed to match the Carolina collection for a classic, refined look
- Personalize the detail: knob tip can be removed and replaced with your own cabinet knob to match existing hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75" x 1.75" x 3.75"
- Hanging space (extension): 2-1/2"
- Weight capacity: up to 15 lb
- Wall type: fits standard interior walls
- Installation: requires drilling one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes; includes toggle bolts and mounting hardware
- Ships at 1.3 lb

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook (Patent Pending)
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your décor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room! Can hold up to 15 pounds Fits standard interior walls Installation does require drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around 2 1/2" of hanging space All mounting hardware included Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 1.75x1.75x3.75 Box dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 12x10x4 Shipping weight, lbs: 1.3 Installation Instruction Technical Specification CL-22-Installation.pdf CL-22-Specification.pdf
